title.en: How NEXTBODY MCP connects health data to ChatGPT and Claude · NEXTBODY
title.zh: NEXTBODY MCP 如何把健康数据接到 ChatGPT 与 Claude · NEXTBODY

description.en: NEXTBODY MCP lets ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot or Muse read your own body data after you sign in. Meal logging is off by default. Advice is not a medical prescription.
description.zh: NEXTBODY MCP 在你本人登录授权后，让 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok Bot 或 Muse 读取你自己的身体数据。记录餐食默认关闭。建议不构成医疗处方。

h1.en: How NEXTBODY MCP connects health data to ChatGPT and Claude
h1.zh: NEXTBODY MCP 如何把健康数据接到 ChatGPT 与 Claude

lede.en: A technical note on what the product site already says about MCP: who can connect, what they can read, and what they must not be used for.
lede.zh: 这篇说明只整理产品站已经写过的 MCP 内容：谁能接入、能读什么、不能当作什么用。

p_intro.en: HOOP is a screenless smart health band (8mm thin, 10g without the strap). The NEXTBODY App is where you read heart rate, sleep staging, training load and a 14-metric Body Scan. MCP is the optional bridge from that account to a third-party assistant.
p_intro.zh: HOOP 是无屏智能健康手环（机身薄至 8mm、轻至 10g，不含表带）。心率、睡眠分期、训练负荷与 14 项身体扫描在 NEXTBODY App 里查看。MCP 是把该账号可选接到第三方助手的桥。

p_what_1.en: NEXTBODY MCP is not a public dump of everyone's data. Connecting a third-party AI assistant requires your own sign-in and authorisation. The assistant can only read data under your account.
p_what_1.zh: NEXTBODY MCP 不会公开所有人的数据。接入第三方 AI 助手需要你本人登录并授权，助手只能读取你自己账号下的数据。

p_what_2.en: Supported assistants named on the site today are ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot and Muse. Names are used to describe compatibility. They do not imply a partnership or endorsement, and the list may change with what the App actually supports.
p_what_2.zh: 站点目前点名的助手是 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok Bot 与 Muse。提及只为说明兼容性，不代表合作或背书；可接入的助手以 App 实际支持为准。

li_assistants.en: Once you authorise it, the assistant can read your own body data from the NEXTBODY App.
li_assistants.zh: 授权后，助手可以读取你在 NEXTBODY App 里自己的身体数据。

li_own_data.en: It cannot read another person's account.

li_sign_in.en: If you do not sign in and authorise the connection, MCP does not share that data.
li_sign_in.zh: 你没有登录并授权，MCP 就不会分享这些数据。

h_meals.en: Meal logging stays off until you turn it on

p_meals.en: Meal logging is off by default. After you turn it on, you can log a meal in one sentence. The assistant confirms the food, portion and time with you before saving. Calories, protein, carbs and fat are estimated from that description — not weighed or lab-tested — and daily targets are general guidance, not a nutrition prescription.
p_meals.zh: 记录餐食默认关闭。打开后可以用一句话记下这一餐；保存前助手会与你确认食物、份量和时间。热量、蛋白质、碳水与脂肪按描述估算，不是称重或实验室测定；每日目标是一般性建议，不构成营养处方。

p_app.en: MCP reads the same wellness record the App already shows. The band is screenless; the App is the display. Claims below are the ones already published on nextbody.ai.
p_app.zh: MCP 读的是 App 里已经展示的健康记录。手环无屏，显示在 App。下列表述均已出现在 nextbody.ai。

li_readiness.en: Readiness (0–100) starts from last night's sleep and compares night HRV and resting heart rate with your personal baseline. It is an algorithm estimate for reference only.
li_readiness.zh: 准备度（0–100）以昨晚睡眠为起点，对比夜间 HRV 与静息心率的个人基线。这是算法估算，仅供参考。

li_sleep.en: Sleep score is out of 100, weighted across seven factors by HOOP's own rules. It is not a clinical scale.
li_sleep.zh: 睡眠分数满分 100，由七项因素按 HOOP 自有规则加权。不是临床量表。

li_load.en: Training load (0–21) tallies heart-rate zones and activity every 5 minutes and does not replace a coach.
li_load.zh: 训练负荷（0–21）每 5 分钟结算心率区间与活动量，不能替代教练。

li_scan.en: Body Scan uses bioimpedance plus the height, weight, age and sex in the App to estimate 14 body-composition metrics. Results are estimates, not a medical diagnosis. Do not use Body Scan with a pacemaker or other implanted electronic medical device.
li_scan.zh: 身体扫描用生物电阻抗，再结合 App 中的身高、体重、年龄与性别，估算 14 项身体成分。结果是估算值，不是医疗诊断。植入起搏器等电子医疗设备者请勿使用。

p_limits.en: Once data is sent to a third-party AI service, that service's privacy policy applies, so decide for yourself before connecting. The assistant's analysis and advice are for reference only — not medical, nutrition or training prescriptions. HOOP and the NEXTBODY App are not medical devices and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. If you feel unwell, see a doctor.
p_limits.zh: 数据一旦发给第三方 AI 服务，即按其隐私政策处理，接入前请自行判断。助手的分析与建议仅供参考，不构成医疗、营养或训练处方。HOOP 与 NEXTBODY App 均非医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病。如有不适，请就医。

q_safe.en: Is connecting ChatGPT, Claude or other AI (MCP) safe?
q_safe.zh: 把数据接入 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI（MCP）安全吗？

a_safe.en: You sign in and authorise it yourself, and the assistant can only read your own account's data. Meal logging is off by default; when on, the AI confirms the food, portion and time with you before saving. Once data is sent to a third-party AI service, that service's privacy policy applies, so decide for yourself. The assistant's analysis and advice are for reference only, not medical, nutrition or training prescriptions.
a_safe.zh: 接入需要你本人登录并授权，AI 助手只能读取你自己账号下的数据。记录餐食默认关闭，开启后 AI 会在保存前与你确认食物、份量与时间。数据一旦发送给第三方 AI 服务，将按照该服务的隐私政策处理，请自行评估后使用。AI 助手给出的分析与建议仅供参考，不构成医疗、营养或训练处方。

a_medical.en: No. Neither the HOOP band nor the NEXTBODY App is a medical device, and neither is meant to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Heart rate, SpO2, HRV, skin temperature, sleep, body composition, readiness, training load and related tips are for everyday wellness only, not medical decisions. If you feel unwell, see a doctor.
a_medical.zh: 不是。HOOP 手环与 NEXTBODY App 均非医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病。心率、血氧、HRV、皮肤温度、睡眠、身体成分、准备度、训练负荷等数据与提示仅供日常健康管理参考，不作为诊疗依据。如有身体不适，请及时就医并遵从医生建议。

q_food.en: How accurate are food calories and macros?
q_food.zh: 饮食记录的热量和营养素准确吗？

a_food.en: Calories, protein, carbs and fat are estimated from the food type and portion you describe, not weighed or lab-tested, so they may differ from what you actually ate. Daily targets are general guidance, not a nutrition prescription. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, have a chronic condition or special dietary needs, follow your doctor's advice.
a_food.zh: 餐食的热量、蛋白质、碳水与脂肪基于食物种类与份量描述估算，不是称重或实验室测定结果，可能与实际摄入存在差异。每日热量与营养目标为一般性建议，不构成营养处方；孕期、哺乳期、患有慢性病或有特殊饮食需求的人群请遵医嘱。

disclaimer.en: This note restates published product-site copy. Phone screens on the marketing pages are real App screenshots with demo data; features follow the actual App and may change. Third-party names belong to their owners.
disclaimer.zh: 本文只复述产品站已发布文案。营销页中的手机界面为 App 实拍与演示数据；功能以实际 App 为准，可能随版本变化。第三方名称归其权利人所有。

footer_legal.en: HOOP and the NEXTBODY App are not medical devices and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Data, tips and suggestions are for reference only.
footer_legal.zh: HOOP 与 NEXTBODY App 均非医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病。数据、提示与建议仅供参考。
